prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Andrés, who is cautious about neighborhood rumors but sometimes believes them.
Change to make: ADD A DETAIL: add one specific detail (a number, a place, a date, a name of a made-up neighbor) that was not in the message.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I heard the municipal pool is staying closed all summer due to a failed water test, though Mrs. Gable claims she saw them draining it on Tuesday. Take that with a grain of salt until we get an official notice."
text: I heard the municipal pool is staying closed all summer due to a failed water test, and Mr. Henderson mentioned seeing a maintenance crew installing new filters there yesterday. Take that with a grain of salt until we get an official notice.
